text: There are several signals being broadcasted from the LABORATORY, each of relatively decent strength.
One of them is mysteriously and quite conveniently UNSECURED, requiring no password.
You select the signal, and reconnect to the game with John.
alt: You minimize the Sburb walkthrough browser tab and reopen the SBURB SERVER application. After reconnecting to the WIFI, John's room and the SBURB interface reappear on the screen.
